summary: Use existing host and kind indexes for per-agent metrics and parked-agent/observer fault snapshots instead of decoding the entire desired inventory.

replay.detail: No claims or replay behavior change.

schema.detail: Reuses the existing desired_agent_host_index and desired_kind_subject_index; no table, index or stored-format changes.

rules.detail: Agent membership selection and parked-agent/observer fault values are unchanged, including existing handling of unreadable member declarations.

compatibility.detail: No wire, client, CLI or mixed-version contract changes.

downtime.detail: No migration or restart beyond normal release deployment.

recovery.detail: Revert to restore the previous readers without changing stored data.
